name: complex_video_bench_mini100
description: A 100-task stratified subset of ComplexVideoBench-1K for faster real-model evaluation.
license: Research-only task specifications; source media assets are not bundled.

selection.split_policy: per-family approximately 60/20/20 with scenario groups isolated to one split
selection.scenario_policy: at most one difficulty variant per scenario group
selection.nesting_policy: mini15 is a strict subset of mini50, which is a strict subset of mini100
